text: k. now how about this problem [Image #21] pin stripes of a different flavor this time
resolution: Killed the new 'pinstripes'. Diagnosed via an offscreen atlas dump: a filled face baked as hundreds of ~2px per-ROW boxes (the run-merge only merged horizontally), and at fine cells those adjacent row-boxes left thin horizontal seams between every row despite shared-edge rounding. Fix: replaced the per-row run-merge with a greedy 2D RECTANGLE merge — cellRects() extends a cell right then down while the full width is present, so a solid region becomes ONE box (a fully-filled face = 1 box, zero internal seams); a brush region collapses to a few rects. Added rectAtlasRect() (seamless shared-edge rounding for a cell rectangle) and swapped the bake to use them. Verified with the atlas dump: the previously-striped full face now renders as a single solid box. Build clean; meshPaint 8/8. Needs rjit dev to confirm live on the gun: a painted/filled face should be flat colour with no horizontal seams. shas dc9b7347b.
